messages:
deploybot: Release check for release/2026-03-21-42 blocked by preflight: missing KMS alias 'alias/redwood/inference-prod' in prod (alias present in staging). Release window paused.

maya: noted. grabbing prod KMS list now.

dan: which deploy is this affecting — inference-api or model-cache?

maya: deploybot says inference-api (route: /v1/generate). quick check: `aws kms list-aliases --profile prod | grep inference` returned nothing. staging shows alias.

rachel: ouch. do we have a documented process for backfilling aliases during release? change window ends 22:00 PST. current time ~ 20:55.

paul: short answers: 1) we can create alias pointing to existing CMK id if key exists in prod account 2) if key missing, we'd need key import or cross-account shim -> longer.

maya: running `aws kms list-keys --profile prod --query 'Keys[*].KeyId'` now. looks like the CMK exists: `1234abcd-...` so alias just wasn't created.

dan: where did staging get its alias from? was it created by infra automation?

maya: infra pipeline created it for staging. looks like the templated alias resource was gated by a param that didn't get set for prod in this rollout.

rachel: two immediate options: A) backfill alias in prod now (fast), proceed with deploy retry; B) rollback release to earlier pinned image and postpone until tomorrow. Given change window closing, I'd prefer A if safe.

paul: safety checklist for alias creation: must point to same CMK id, policy bindings identical, and we should rotate metadata to ensure no KMS grants accidentally differ. Also add audit entry. I can perform creation but need an owner to sign off.

maya: @paul can you create alias with `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood/inference-prod --target-key-id 1234abcd-... --profile prod`? I will prepare a minimal smoke check and rollout retry.

paul: doing it now. will post command output.

sre-bot: [audit] create-alias attempted by paul@redwood 2026-03-21T20:59:02Z

paul: command succeeded: {"ResponseMetadata": {"HTTPStatusCode": 200}}

maya: nice. quick smoke: redeploying canary 1/5 for inference-api with pinned image sha abcdef1 and watching /health and /v1/generate with a small prompt.

dan: to confirm rollback plan remains available: we have previous image tag 2026-03-20-stable pinned as fallback. noted.

maya: smoke looks good: canary passed 3 sequential requests, latency within SLO.

rachel: agree proceed. i'll update release notes and the rollout message (and add postmortem stub to document missing alias param). also adding a note to infra templating PR to make alias param required for prod.

deploybot: Release check retried: blocked condition cleared. Release unpaused. Starting rollout to 50% -> 100% per rollout policy.

paul: added audit entry in #infra-audit and created a tiny runbook snippet in the release ticket: "If deploybot flags missing alias, verify CMK and create alias pointing at same key id; require infra owner to sign off."

rachel: update to release notes: "Hotpatch: backfilled missing KMS alias in prod that blocked rollout. No user-facing impact observed. Follow-up: infra template parameter made required."

dan: leaving pinned rollback tag in the release ticket in case of regression. I'm going to watch metrics for 15m then call stable.

maya: marking rollout as recovered in the runbook and adding timeline.

sre-bot: [monitoring] 15m window started for release/2026-03-21-42, alerting level: standard.

deploybot: Rollout status: 100% success. Thread closed by deploybot at 2026-03-21T21:06:45Z."
